story.fullStory:
Elvis Crespo's "Suavemente" reached #84 on the Billboard Hot 100. "Suavemente" (English: "Softly") is a song recorded and composed by Puerto Rican merengue singer Elvis Crespo on his first solo album, Suavemente, which followed his departure from Grupo Manía.

The song peaked at #84 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 2 weeks on the chart.

Suavemente was released in 1998.

"Suavemente" (English: "Softly") is a song recorded and composed by Puerto Rican merengue singer Elvis Crespo on his first solo album, Suavemente, which followed his departure from Grupo Manía.
Released as the lead single, "Suavemente" reached number one on the Billboard Hot Latin Tracks on May 16, 1998, and remained atop the chart for six weeks.
Crespo re-recorded it with Spanglish lyrics.
